JOIN INNER [col("s")] = [col("m")] no coalesce swap_at_runtime
  left:
    CACHE #1
      AGGREGATE [col("region")] -> [col("qty").sum().alias("s")]
        MEMORY SCAN 6 rows
          projection: [region, qty] (2/6 cols)
  right:
    AGGREGATE [] -> [col("s").max().alias("m")]
      CACHE #1
        AGGREGATE [col("region")] -> [col("qty").sum().alias("s")]
          MEMORY SCAN 6 rows
            projection: [region, qty] (2/6 cols)
